name: x_post
description: POSTS IN PUBLIC, COSTS MONEY: publish a post on X. Returns { data: { id, text } }; the id is what x_delete_post takes. Attach images by uploading them with x_upload_media first and passing --media_ids. Text is capped at 280 characters unless the account is on a Pro tier. Every call is billed per post under X's pay-per-use pricing. If this fails, read the error and stop — retrying is how the same thing gets posted twice.

text.description: The post, up to 280 characters. Newlines are fine. Links count as 23 characters whatever their length.

reply_to.description: Post id to reply to. The reply is public unless the conversation is restricted.

poll_minutes.description: How long the poll runs, 5-10080 minutes.

reply_settings.description: Who may reply: 'following' or 'mentionedUsers'. Default is everyone.

media_ids.description: Ids from x_upload_media: up to 4 images, or 1 GIF. Attaching media to a reply or quote is fine.
